newsitem.title: FRANCE: Former Algerian general killed - security sources.
newsitem.headline: Former Algerian general killed - security sources.

text.p: Moslem rebels killed an Algerian former army general on Thursday in the western Algerian city of Oran, Algerian security forces said.

The Algerian security forces said in a statement on the official Algerian news agency APS that former general Habib Khelil was "assassinated by terrorists", the term they use to describe Moslem guerrillas.

The killing took place in Oran at 1.15 p.m (1215 GMT), shortly after top union leader Abdelhak Benhamouda, who was shot dead on Tuesday in central Algiers, was buried in al Alia cemetery in the Algerian capital.
